reason: The user changed the primary objective from consensus/coverage to oracle best-of-100 accuracy after the original full arms were launched.
primary_metric: Mean across proteins of validity_gated_oracle_r_precision at N=100, reported separately for all-range and long-range contacts.
validity_policy: A rollout is assigned zero accuracy if it is unfinished or contains any malformed contact statement. All other rollouts are scored by emission-order precision at exp89's R cutoff; duplicate contacts occupy only their first rank.

new_full_arms.purpose: Direct test of the user's pure native/null likelihood-ratio proposal.
Ordinary high-temperature diversity control, including up to 200 rollouts for equal-time comparisons.

selection_note: The frozen gamma=0.5 all-token arm was retained because it was already running on the untouched split and was essentially tied with gamma=2 on dev oracle accuracy. The pure-ratio and T=1.1 arms are confirmatory controls, not a post-hoc replacement of the frozen arm.
